name: RAMS Global
verdict: The construction and real-estate brand of RAMS Holding (Turkey).
note: Rating note: RAMS Global's logo sits below the back number on Fenerbahce's BSL shirts (front, under the chest logo, in EuroLeague games) since 2025/26. Its owner, RAMS Holding, is a Turkish construction group; no state or fund ownership was found in this pass, but the chain was not confirmed against a primary filing. ON HOLD: proposed 'none' waits on confirmation of the owner chain from a second, independent source.
